info.title: Element Pay Partner API
info.description: Provider-neutral partner APIs for fiat ↔ crypto corridors and deposit accounts. Discover corridors, create a binding quote, accept it, and receive webhooks. Onboard entities, open fiat and USDC deposit accounts, move funds with same-currency book transfers, convert between fiat and USDC via quote/accept, send USDC, fund fiat accounts via card charges, and issue disposable or virtual cards on active USD accounts. African local fiat is auto-routed by corridor.

Single indicative catalog for partner checkout: per-country onramp/offramp, `mobile_money` and `bank` buckets with live provider lists, optional `rails` for international payout markets, and `international_bank` for EUR/USD payin.

### Provider IDs
`providers[].id` is the opaque institution UUID to send as `payment_method.network_id` on quote. Bank rows may also use [`GET /partner/banks`](/partner/banks).

Each provider includes `min_amount`, `max_amount`, and `currency` for checkout validation.

<Warning>
**OnRamp and OffRamp provider lists can differ** for the same country — filter with `order_type`.
</Warning>

Optional filters: `country`, `currency`, `order_type`. Omit filters for the full tree.

<Note>
Binding eligibility: [`POST /partner/orders/quote`](/partner/orders/quote).
</Note>

x-mint.content:
Indicative payment methods for one corridor.

### African corridors
- **`country`** — required
- **`currency`** — optional; must match the catalog when sent; response `context` always includes both
- **`order_type`** — `OnRamp` or `OffRamp`; omit to get both `onramp` and `offramp` buckets

### International bank
- **`currency`** = EUR or USD (required)
- Do **not** pass `country`
- EUR/USD onramp returns `bank`
- Offramp uses international bank when configured

### International bank payout markets
Example: FR + EUR offramp — pass `country` + `currency`. Returns rails such as `BankSepa` and `BankSwift` with `type` set to the international bank `PaymentMethodType`.

### Local fiat (African)
`mobile_money` and `bank` rows include a **`networks[]`** list (`id`, `name`, `min_amount`, `max_amount`, `currency`) for client-side amount gating.

<Note>
Binding check: [`POST /partner/orders/quote`](/partner/orders/quote).
</Note>

x-mint.content:
Lists bank/network institution options for a rail chosen via [`GET /partner/payment-methods`](/partner/payment-methods).

### Query
`country`, `currency`, `order_type` (`OnRamp` | `OffRamp`), and `payment_method_type`.

### Rails
- **`bank`** (local fiat) — active networks only; use returned `banks[].id` as `payment_method.network_id` on quote
- **`mobile_money`** — returns **422**; use [`GET /partner/catalog`](/partner/catalog) `providers[].id` for momo `network_id`
- International bank types (e.g. `BankSepa`, `BankSwift`) — best-effort enum options from upstream form schema

post.description: Create a binding quote for a fiat ↔ crypto order. **Flow:** create a quote → show the returned amounts and payment instructions to the user → accept the `quote_id` with `POST /partner/orders/{quote_id}/accept`. **Discovery before quote:** - `GET /partner/catalog` or `GET /partner/payment-methods` → rails for the corridor. - `GET /partner/catalog?order_type=OnRamp|OffRamp` → `providers[].id` for momo/bank. - `GET /partner/order-requirements` → exact field names (`network_id` required for momo/bank). - `GET /partner/banks` → bank institution UUIDs where applicable. **Payment method by rail:** - **`mobile_money`**: `payment_method.type=mobile_money`, `payment_method.phone_number` (E.164), and `payment_method.network_id` (UUID from catalog `providers[].id`). - **`bank`**: `payment_method.type=bank`, `account_number`, `account_name`, and `payment_method.network_id` (from `GET /partner/banks` or catalog). **OnRamp response** includes `payment_instructions` — show these to the user before accept. `provider` is optional. When omitted, ElementPay auto-routes by corridor. **Quote id formats:** `yc_receive_<id>` (OnRamp), `yc_send_<id>` (OffRamp). The quote expires at `data.expires_at`.

x-mint.content:
Create a binding quote for a fiat ↔ crypto order.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Create quote">
    `POST` with corridor, customer, and payment method details.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Show pricing">
    Display returned amounts and **payment instructions** to the user (OnRamp).
  </Step>
  <Step title="Accept">
    [`POST /partner/orders/{quote_id}/accept`](/partner/orders/{quote_id}/accept) when the user confirms.
  </Step>
</Steps>

### Discovery before quote
- [`GET /partner/catalog`](/partner/catalog) or [`GET /partner/payment-methods`](/partner/payment-methods) → rails for the corridor
- [`GET /partner/catalog?order_type=OnRamp`](/partner/catalog) or `OffRamp` → `providers[].id` for momo/bank
- [`GET /partner/order-requirements`](/partner/order-requirements) → exact field names (`network_id` required for momo/bank)
- [`GET /partner/banks`](/partner/banks) → bank institution UUIDs where applicable

### Payment method by rail
**`mobile_money`**
- `payment_method.type=mobile_money`
- `payment_method.phone_number` (E.164)
- `payment_method.network_id` (UUID from catalog `providers[].id`)

**`bank`**
- `payment_method.type=bank`
- `account_number`, `account_name`
- `payment_method.network_id` (from [`GET /partner/banks`](/partner/banks) or catalog)

`provider` is optional — when omitted, ElementPay auto-routes by corridor.

### Quote IDs
- OnRamp: `yc_receive_<id>`
- OffRamp: `yc_send_<id>`

The quote expires at `data.expires_at`.

post.description: Accepts a quote returned by `/partner/orders/quote`. For local fiat rail, the `quote_id` already contains the provider and direction, so the request body can be `{}`. international bank quote ids work the same way. Accepting creates or returns the local ElementPay order, copies the API key webhook URL, and triggers partner webhook notifications as the order moves through `order.processing`, `order.settled`, `order.failed`, or `order.refunded`. This route is idempotent for already accepted local fiat rail previews: retries return the existing local order.

empty.description: Most callers can send an empty object; provider is inferred from quote_id.

webhooks.delivery: ElementPay will notify the webhook_url configured on the API key.

provider.description: Optional route override. Omit for ElementPay auto-routing. Use `elementpay` for native on-chain routes; `local fiat rail` and `bank` for ramp providers.

order_type.title: Order Type
order_type.description: OnRamp = fiat to crypto. OffRamp = crypto to fiat. Aliases also accepted at runtime: onramp/offramp and integers 0/1.

token.title: Token
token.description: Token contract address or route token hint. local fiat rail currently requires Base USDC or Polygon USDT address.

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: Canonical crypto asset block. Use `token` for contract-address based routes and `currency` + `network` for provider currency routes.

subject_type.title: Subject Type
subject_type.description: Stable subject type for providers that require pre-approved PSP customer links (for example bank USD/EUR IBAN payins).

subject_id.title: Subject Id
subject_id.description: Stable subject id used to resolve provider approval/onboarding state.

crypto_currency.title: Crypto Currency
crypto_currency.description: Provider crypto currency hint, e.g. USDC or USDC_TEST for bank.

crypto_network.title: Crypto Network
crypto_network.description: Provider network hint, e.g. Base or PolygonTestAmoy for bank.

customer.title: Customer
customer.description: Provider-neutral customer details. Used to derive provider party details when provider-specific fields are omitted.

payment_method.title: Payment Method
payment_method.description: Provider-neutral fiat rail. For ``type: mobile_money`` use ``phone_number`` (MSISDN) and ``network_id`` (institution UUID from catalog ``providers[].id``). For ``type: bank`` use ``network_id`` from catalog/``GET /banks``. ElementPay ledger FX (EUR/USD/GBP ↔ USDC) also requires ``entity_id`` and ``account_id`` (partner integers from ``/partner/entities/.../accounts``): OnRamp ``account_id`` is the fiat source; OffRamp ``account_id`` is the USDC source (optional ``destination_account_id`` for the fiat credit account). Do not use top-level legacy fields.

PartnerOrderQuoteRequest.title: PartnerOrderQuoteRequest
PartnerOrderQuoteRequest.description: Generic partner quote request for the `quote -> accept -> webhook` flow. `provider` is optional. When omitted, the partner order router selects the route from country, currency, order type, payment method, asset, and amount. New partner integrations should use the canonical `asset`, `customer`, and `payment_method` blocks. For local fiat rail momo/bank, ``payment_method.network_id`` is required (catalog or ``GET /banks``). For mobile money MSISDN, use ``payment_method.phone_number`` only — do not fall back to ``customer.phone``. Legacy provider-specific blocks (``destination``, etc.) are still accepted and mapped to the canonical request fields.

network.title: Network
network.description: Required for stablecoin (Base or Polygon); ignored for fiat

PartnerEntityAccountOpenRequest.title: PartnerEntityAccountOpenRequest
PartnerEntityAccountOpenRequest.description: Open a fiat IBAN or stablecoin deposit account for an approved entity.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Partner-stable id; forwarded as upstream unique_reference

PartnerEntityBookTransferConfirmRequest.title: PartnerEntityBookTransferConfirmRequest
PartnerEntityBookTransferConfirmRequest.description: Confirm a previewed book-transfer using the signed preview token.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Decimal amount in account currency, e.g. 10.50

PartnerEntityBookTransferPreviewRequest.title: PartnerEntityBookTransferPreviewRequest
PartnerEntityBookTransferPreviewRequest.description: Preview a same-currency fiat book-transfer between two accounts under this API key.

tax_id.title: Tax Id
tax_id.description: Tax identifier. Required for US-incorporated businesses as a 9-digit EIN (e.g. 123456789 or 12-3456789).

monthly_payments_count.title: Monthly Payments Count
monthly_payments_count.description: Accepted as int or digit-string (e.g. 12 or "12")

monthly_transaction_value.title: Monthly Transaction Value
monthly_transaction_value.description: Accepted as int or digit-string (e.g. 250000 or "250000")

PartnerEntityBusinessProfileAttachReques.title: PartnerEntityBusinessProfileAttachRequest
PartnerEntityBusinessProfileAttachReques.description: Supply the missing KYB business data before submit. Amount fields (``monthly_payments_count``, ``monthly_transaction_value``, ``max_transfer_amount``, ``annual_turnover``) may be sent as ints or digit-strings; we accept both. Upstream receives them as JSON strings.

key.title: Key
key.description: For individual flows: identity or address. For business flows: certificate_of_incorporation, memorandum_of_association, proof_of_address, tax_verification, plus identity/address for officer documents.

PartnerEntityIdentificationAttachRequest.title: PartnerEntityIdentificationAttachRequest
PartnerEntityIdentificationAttachRequest.description: Link uploaded documents + residential address before submit (required on live). Person fields are optional when the entity was created via ``POST /entities/individuals`` — omitted values are filled from the create-time snapshot.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: Id returned from POST .../documents with key=identity

parent_entity_id.title: Parent Entity Id
parent_entity_id.description: Optional parent entity id override; defaults to ElementPay root

liveness_check_id.title: Liveness Check Id
liveness_check_id.description: Optional biometric report id; not required unless compliance asks

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: Id returned from POST .../documents with key=address

PartnerEntityResidentialAddress.title: PartnerEntityResidentialAddress
PartnerEntityResidentialAddress.description: Partner address shape; mapped to upstream ``country_code`` on attach.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Partner-stable id; same key returns the prior send

PartnerEntitySendConfirmRequest.title: PartnerEntitySendConfirmRequest
PartnerEntitySendConfirmRequest.description: Confirm a previewed send using the signed preview token.

network.title: Network
network.description: Must match the account network when set (Base or Polygon)

PartnerEntitySendPreviewRequest.title: PartnerEntitySendPreviewRequest
PartnerEntitySendPreviewRequest.description: Preview a same-asset USDC send (fee + receive amount; not an FX quote).

liveness_check_id.title: Liveness Check Id
liveness_check_id.description: Optional; supply if compliance required liveness after a prior attempt

browser_info.title: Browser Info
browser_info.description: Browser data for 3DS; required when auth_model is 3ds_required

PartnerEntityCardChargeCreateRequest.title: PartnerEntityCardChargeCreateRequest
PartnerEntityCardChargeCreateRequest.description: Charge a card into this fiat account (card acquiring / deposit).

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Optional. Not a prepaid load; the card spends against the active USD account balance. PAN/CVV are create-only.

expiration_year.title: Expiration Year
expiration_year.description: YY or YYYY — required for disposable

spending_controls.description: Optional spend limits; applied for virtual cards only

PartnerEntityIssuedCardCreateRequest.title: PartnerEntityIssuedCardCreateRequest
PartnerEntityIssuedCardCreateRequest.description: Issue a disposable or virtual card on an active USD fiat account.

PartnerEntityIssuedCardSpendingControls.title: PartnerEntityIssuedCardSpendingControls
PartnerEntityIssuedCardSpendingControls.description: Optional controls for virtual cards (major units for amount limits).
